title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in David Lingren Media…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Media Library Assistant plugin by David Lingren, allowing improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This vulnerability affects versions up to and including 3.43. The flaw could allow an attacker to inject code, potentially leading to limited confidentiality impact without requiring user interaction or privileges.
